user_can_forget: CACHE: old snapshots, intermediate outputs, working drafts
STALE: retired claims, superseded decisions, resolved blockers
DUPLICATE: lower-tier copies of same evidence
Entire project Context Space (with PLAN → CONFIRM)
user_cannot_forget_without_explicit_flag: CORE_EVIDENCE: verifier results, final reports, SHA256, governance JSONs — requires --force-evidence
user_cannot_forget_ever: Real project files (not in Context Space scope)
forget_is_not: Removal from backups or version control
Retroactive — deleted records may exist in old snapshots until those snapshots age out
